requirements.text: Move deterministic checks under flat src/checks/** and make src/audit/** a facade.
Rename quality concepts/modules to policy and centralize gate requirements there.
Make gateway own pass/fail/block gate engine by moving/renaming validation implementation into src/gateway/**.
Standardize live internal agent tool names to wiki_* without compatibility aliases.

summary: Accepted architecture rename: checks/policy/gateway/audit layers and wiki_* agent tool namespace.

diff_table.current_state: Deterministic audit logic lives under src/audit/**, and a proposed future src/checks/profiles/** shape would still preserve a nested profiles layer.
diff_table.current_project_state: Deterministic audit logic lives under src/audit/**, and a proposed future src/checks/profiles/** shape would still preserve a nested profiles layer.
diff_table.desired_state: Deterministic check modules live directly under a source-owned checks layer, without a profiles subdirectory: src/checks/file-structure.ts, src/checks/horizontal-alignment.ts, etc. src/audit/** becomes a facade/tool surface only.
diff_table.agreed_change: Move deterministic evidence engines under flat src/checks/** modules and keep src/audit/** as the user/agent-facing audit facade.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Checks own facts; audit owns inspection UX/tool orchestration; no src/checks/profiles/** directory is introduced.
diff_table.rationale: User wants a flatter source layout and clearer naming where audit is an action/tool rather than evidence engine ownership.

diff_table.current_state: Quality owns production-readiness policy but overlaps semantically with validation/gateway naming.
diff_table.current_project_state: Quality owns production-readiness policy but overlaps semantically with validation/gateway naming.
diff_table.desired_state: Rename quality concepts/modules to policy. Policy owns gate requirements, risk tiers, required checks/proofs, and approvals; it does not run checks or emit pass/fail/block verdicts.
diff_table.agreed_change: Rename quality to policy and make policy the source owner for gate requirements, risk tiers, required checks/proofs, and approvals.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Policy is rule/config ownership only; checks produce evidence and gateway emits verdicts.
diff_table.rationale: Policy better names the rule layer and avoids overlap with gateway verdicts.
alternatives: Keep quality as a production-profile-only module.

diff_table.current_state: src/validation/** owns pass/fail/block reports while src/gateway/** exists separately as transaction/catalog plumbing, making the gateway concept split across layers.
diff_table.current_project_state: src/validation/** owns pass/fail/block reports while src/gateway/** exists separately as transaction/catalog plumbing, making the gateway concept split across layers.
diff_table.desired_state: Gateway becomes the primary pass/fail/block decision layer. Validation implementation/report/preflight code moves into or is renamed under src/gateway/**, and current gateway transaction/catalog code becomes thin orchestration inside that layer.
diff_table.agreed_change: Move/rename validation gate engine into gateway ownership; gateway owns pass/fail/block lifecycle decisions and current gateway plumbing becomes part of that layer.
diff_table.expected_final_state: src/gateway/** owns report/preflight/tool/transaction/gate semantics; validation is no longer a separate generic source layer.
diff_table.rationale: Gateway is the important architecture concept; validation is too generic and currently splits gate ownership.
alternatives: Keep src/validation and only rename tool text to gateway.

diff_table.current_state: Internal agent tools use codewiki_* names, recently including codewiki_roadmap; user-facing commands use /wiki-* names.
diff_table.current_project_state: Internal agent tools use codewiki_* names, recently including codewiki_roadmap; user-facing commands use /wiki-* names.
diff_table.desired_state: Standardize internal agent tool namespace to wiki_<name> (for example wiki_state, wiki_resume_context, wiki_roadmap, wiki_gateway, wiki_audit), with no compatibility aliases if accepted.
diff_table.agreed_change: Adopt full wiki_* internal agent tool namespace (approve B), including wiki_gateway, wiki_roadmap, wiki_state, wiki_audit, etc.; remove codewiki_* compatibility aliases when implemented.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Agent/internal API and user-facing command naming align around wiki_*; historical artifacts may mention old names but live tool registration/docs/tests do not.
diff_table.rationale: User wants standardized internal agent API naming and is willing to fix breakage rather than preserve aliases.
alternatives: Rename only codewiki_validation to codewiki_gateway and keep codewiki_* namespace.
Use wiki_gateway for gateway but keep other tools as codewiki_*.
